help.title: Welcome to OSS Browser Neo
help.start: Enter your region and AccessKey on the opening screen. Once connected, select a bucket and click a filename to open a folder or view details.
help.connect: Manage multiple connections from the startup screen or Settings. Save stores credentials without contacting OSS; Connect verifies access before switching. Edit saved connection details or replace expired STS credentials. Deleting a saved connection does not disconnect the active session.
help.scope: Files are limited to 100 MB and transferred sequentially without overwriting existing objects. Only files and empty folders can be deleted. Resumable transfers, folder downloads, and ACL editing are not yet supported.
help.shortcuts: Press ⌘ / Ctrl + K to search this folder. Stars are saved on this device. Transfer history resets when the connection changes or the app restarts.
